name: Momozono Momo
source: Childhood friend of the protagonist; after briefly reuniting by chance she found him to be intolerable. Is desperately in need of a job/money when she applies for a café job. Little did she know the ad she applied to was a maid café and happened to be an interview for a maid. Initially was against the job, but once she found out how much money she'd make she eventually agreed.
